purpose: Refresh the external ML-systems task inventory by collecting only the incremental GitHub PR metadata merged on 2026-10-31 UTC, after the prior metadata scan ended on 2026-10-30.
hypothesis: A one-day incremental metadata-only scan can reveal a recent merged repair candidate without reopening consumed tasks or touching PR source and test contents.
primary_output: An immutable metadata pool with a coarse manual-review screen. No row from this output is qualified or assigned to a split.

discovery.api: GitHub GraphQL Search and PullRequest metadata fields

coarse_screen.meaning: Metadata-only provisional shortlist for later manual review. This is not task qualification, family independence, pretraining independence, or Development split assignment.

stop_rules: Preserve metadata failures; do not silently omit a repository, search page, or pull-request metadata response.
Stop if a search exceeds 1,000 results for a repository or the aggregate metadata request ceiling is exceeded.
Do not retrieve PR bodies, comments, review discussion, patches, source, tests, task prompts, or grader artifacts.
Do not inspect, identify, report, or use any historical Held-Out task or artifact; filter Held-Out rows before extracting prior identity fields.

Keep every candidate UNQUALIFIED and UNASSIGNED until a separate frozen protocol authorizes source/test qualification, exposure review, license review, baseline/fix/mutant controls, and isolation checks.
limitations: The scan covers only six specified repositories and the 2026-10-31 UTC date; it is not a global task inventory.
A merged date after the 2025-08-09 public model training-completion proxy does not prove absence from pretraining.
Titles and changed paths do not establish executable regression, objective grader independence, CPU feasibility, task-family independence, or model capability.
This scan authorizes no model attempt, optimizer update, Held-Out access, or training.
